segments.script: Maintain Pavements introduces SuperBase: a five-step process for turning suitable existing yard base into bound hardstand.
First, prepare. Remove loose material and scarify the base to about seventy-five millimetres.
Second, dose and mix. Add SuperBase and water at the designed ratio, mixing through the full depth.
Third, grade to level. Trim the workable base to the designed level and crossfall for drainage.
Fourth, roll and compact. Use wet rolling, then check density against the dosage design.
Fifth, cure and return to service. Timing varies with base material, climate and duty.
Start with a trial area. Laboratory testing compares your material before treatment and after cure. Contact Jon Pepper.
